question: How do documented one-hour delivery prices change the 69-name extension?
single_variable: Replace all funded retirement-price markouts with the documented one-hour native index mean. Keep the separate CVC history-gap exit in the frozen input and explicitly identify it.
costs: Known zero delivery fees for CATI/TREE. The three 2025 notices do not specify a delivery fee. Use zero to 5bp on those deliveries as a sensitivity; no market slippage at delivery. Fee-only low/high index marks and an additional 5bp market-slippage case. No funding.
scope: Native minute index OHLC prices approximate the published one-hour mean. The venue retains discretion to adjust the settlement. One unresolved CVC October 2022 projection from the native candle gap remains in all scenarios.
